Spoken lines are referenced by id and read from the dialogue catalog, never retyped here. Answer keys live in profiles/campaign_rules.json (chapter6).

P-11.title: Protect the Small Light
hints: Five essentials plus one pump and one camera equal seven.
Keep essentials ON, prepare pump in 1 and camera in 2, with floodlights OFF.
P-11.mastery: Five acknowledged segments, no blackout, live garden, and at least 2 battery units at recovery (accepted plan keeps 7).

first_time_card.title: Protect the small light
first_time_card.purpose: Plan the five eclipse segments while keeping life support, the garden and the guide light warm.
steps: Keep the essential package on in all five eclipse segments.
Prepare the return pump in segment 1 and the filtered camera in segment 2.
Leave decorative floodlights off so the 7-unit recovery reserve stays whole.
first_time_card.clip: Planning the five eclipse segments (explainer clip pending)

P-12.title: Observe, Isolate, Restore
hints: Isolate the failed feeder before reset.
Feeder off, confirm zero, reset, reconnect, camera test.
P-12.mastery: Camera branch restored in sequence without touching the protected main bus, ingress/ring/egress recorded, and recovery reserve reconciled at 7.

first_time_card.title: Observe, isolate, restore
first_time_card.purpose: Use the filtered camera to observe the red ring and safely restore the tripped camera branch.
steps: Log ingress and the red ring through the filtered camera.
When the camera feeder trips, isolate it and confirm zero current before resetting.
Reconnect and test the camera branch only, then record egress.
first_time_card.clip: Isolating and restoring the camera feeder (explainer clip pending)

EX-CH06-S01.title: The Scratched Lamp
EX-CH06-S01.story_date: 12 January 2047 · power room and hand-light locker
EX-CH06-S01.goal: Charge the hand light, assign a companion on channel, and check the locker
EX-CH06-S01.why: A human need is planned as a known load, not hidden.

clues.text: The scratched hand light from the first night gets a measured charge.
The guide light goes on the protected list alongside air circulation, minimum heat and dim growth light.

EX-CH06-S01.aha: What Kai needs is a known way through the dark, not a bright room.
EX-CH06-S01.wrong_idea: Hide the fear or burn decorative floodlights across the corridor.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Protect the 7-unit recovery reserve in the 14-unit battery jar.
EX-CH06-S01.set_piece: Kai clips the charged hand lamp where both hands stay free.

EX-CH06-S02.title: A Known Way Through
EX-CH06-S02.goal: Read the personal log, trace the protected guide-light path, and review the fault-isolation method
EX-CH06-S02.why: Knowing when the light returns and which branch is protected turns fear into a checklist.

clues.text: Kai's memory log explains why an unscheduled blackout felt endless.
The guide-light branch is drawn on every one of the five eclipse segment cards.

EX-CH06-S02.aha: Every segment card shows the guide-light branch and its contact time.
EX-CH06-S02.wrong_idea: Switch everything off during totality to save battery.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Keep essential services active across all five eclipse segments.
EX-CH06-S02.set_piece: Five eclipse segment cards line the board: precharge, ingress, totality, egress and recovery.

EX-CH06-S03.title: Seven Units for the Eclipse
EX-CH06-S03.goal: Commit the 7-unit eclipse allocation (5 essentials + 1 pump + 1 camera) while keeping 7 in reserve
EX-CH06-S03.why: Five essentials plus one pump and one camera equal seven, leaving the recovery reserve whole.

clues.text: Five segments (essentials 1 each), pump readiness 1 before deadline, camera readiness 1 before deadline; decorative floods cost 3 each.

EX-CH06-S03.aha: Five essentials plus one pump and one camera equal seven — one accounting model, seven kept for recovery.
EX-CH06-S03.wrong_idea: Spend decorative floodlights (3 units each) and dip into the 7-unit recovery reserve.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Eclipse allocation must not exceed 7 units out of the 14-unit jar.

risk.title: Recovery reserve breached by decorative floods

EX-CH06-S03.set_piece: The 14-unit battery jar locks its 7-unit recovery bracket as the five segments turn green.

EX-CH06-S04.title: Matched Previews
EX-CH06-S04.goal: Remove decorative floodlights, protect the guide light, and lock the 7-unit recovery reserve
EX-CH06-S04.why: A matched comparison isolates one changed load and proves the guide light meets the need.

clues.text: Matched preview: decorative floods versus guide light under the same equipment.

EX-CH06-S04.aha: Shed decorative floods; keep the guide-light branch on every segment.
EX-CH06-S04.wrong_idea: Keep the corridor floods on so the room never dims.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Shed non-essential floodlights to preserve the 7-unit recovery reserve.
EX-CH06-S04.set_piece: The corridor dims to planned eclipse lighting while the guide-light path stays bright.

EX-CH06-S05.title: Rehearse on the Safe Branch
EX-CH06-S05.goal: Test the non-essential branch disconnect, verify protected services hold, and record the rehearsal
EX-CH06-S05.why: An isolation boundary limits what a fault can reach.

clues.text: Predict the affected branch before throwing the safe test disconnect.
Ferreira reminds the crew that a rehearsal pass does not sign the watch.

EX-CH06-S05.aha: The test branch drops while the protected bus and guide light stay untouched.
EX-CH06-S05.wrong_idea: Expect a camera-branch fault to black out the whole habitat.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Never trip the protected main bus during a branch fault rehearsal.
EX-CH06-S05.set_piece: The test breaker clicks open and closed while the habitat fans hum without a hitch.

EX-CH06-S06.title: Ready Means All of Us
EX-CH06-S06.story_date: 12 January 2047 · mission table and filtered camera
EX-CH06-S06.goal: Collect all four role reports, acknowledge all five segments, and verify the camera protective filter
EX-CH06-S06.why: Ready is the sum of acknowledged specialist reports, not one confident voice.

clues.text: Mei checks plants, Amara checks atmosphere, Rafi checks shelter, lamp and local channel.
Kai confirms readiness only after every station reports in.

EX-CH06-S06.wrong_idea: Sign the eclipse watch before checking the camera filter and all four role reports.
flight_rules: FR-01 · Complete the four-role Go/No-Go poll and filter check before eclipse ingress.
EX-CH06-S06.set_piece: Kai looks around the occupied work positions before calling the station ready.

EX-CH06-S07.title: Every Sunrise and Sunset at Once
EX-CH06-S07.story_date: 12 January 2047 · 23:40 to 00:50 UTC · filtered remote-camera monitor
EX-CH06-S07.goal: Log eclipse ingress and the red ring through the filtered camera
EX-CH06-S07.why: The red rim is sunlight bent through Earth's atmosphere at every sunrise and sunset at once.

clues.text: Filtered camera shows a dark disc taking a bite, then a copper-red ring around Earth.
Conceptual cross-section diagram explains light bending through Earth's air.

EX-CH06-S07.aha: The red is sunlight bent through Earth's air: every sunrise and sunset at once.
EX-CH06-S07.wrong_idea: Claim a geographically resolved country stripe from the conceptual atmosphere diagram.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Label camera frames as observed and the atmosphere cross-section as a conceptual diagram.
EX-CH06-S07.set_piece: On the monitor, a thin copper-red ring circles the dark Earth.

EX-CH06-S08.title: Hello from the Lamp Department
EX-CH06-S08.story_date: 13 January 2047 · 01:00 UTC · Earth family audio link
EX-CH06-S08.goal: Deliver the family audio greeting during the valid communication window and preserve observation qualifications
EX-CH06-S08.why: Communication depends on a verified path window, and observations keep their qualification chips.

clues.text: Family audio reaches Aurora through the valid Earth window.
Rafi answers on the shared channel from the lamp department.

EX-CH06-S08.aha: The call connects because the path window is valid, and no one stands alone.
EX-CH06-S08.wrong_idea: Strip the qualification labels from the eclipse packet sent with the greeting.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Preserve observed, diagram and scenario labels on every shared record.
EX-CH06-S08.set_piece: Kai's family hears Rafi's voice right beside him on the channel.

EX-CH06-S09.title: I Watched a Red Ring From There Once
EX-CH06-S09.story_date: 13 January 2047 · 01:30 UTC · message log and eclipse desk
EX-CH06-S09.goal: Store Noor's text note as known correspondence with its earlier date left unspecified, and keep live voice reserved
EX-CH06-S09.why: Inventing a date for a memory would look scientific and be less true.

clues.text: Noor's text message recalls watching a red ring from Aurora once.
Amara leaves the earlier eclipse date field unspecified and saves records locally before the next segment.

EX-CH06-S09.aha: A sincere memory is indexed honestly without inventing a date.
EX-CH06-S09.wrong_idea: Fill in a guessed historical eclipse date not stated in Noor's message.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Save observation records locally before totality ends; never invent unstated dates.
EX-CH06-S09.set_piece: The local save indicator clicks green moments before the camera view screen drops.

EX-CH06-S10.title: The Guide Light Stayed On
EX-CH06-S10.story_date: 13 January 2047 · 01:55 UTC · power room and camera feeder
EX-CH06-S10.goal: Restore the tripped camera feeder in five ordered steps: isolate, confirm zero, reset, reconnect, test camera branch
EX-CH06-S10.why: A bounded fault deserves a bounded response; the protected main bus stays untouched.

clues.text: The camera screen drops, but the guide light and essential habitat services hold steady.
Rafi stays on the local channel as Kai works the feeder procedure.

EX-CH06-S10.aha: The guide light stayed on: the plan worked before I fixed anything.
EX-CH06-S10.wrong_idea: Reset the breaker before isolating the feeder, or trip the protected main habitat bus.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Do NOT trip the protected main bus; isolate the faulted feeder and verify zero current before reset.

risk.title: Reset before isolation or main-bus trip

EX-CH06-S10.set_piece: Under the steady glow of the guide light, the camera breaker resets and the red rim returns to the monitor.

EX-CH06-S11.title: The Light That Returns
EX-CH06-S11.story_date: 13 January 2047 · 03:09 UTC · restored camera and debrief board
EX-CH06-S11.goal: Record eclipse egress on the restored camera, reconcile the 7-unit recovery reserve, and save the recovery log
EX-CH06-S11.why: Egress waits for verified branch restoration, and the 7-unit reserve reconciles without a hidden fault penalty.

clues.text: Egress frame joins ingress and ring on the debrief board; battery reconciles at 7 units.

EX-CH06-S11.aha: Three observation records — ingress, ring and restored egress — with 7 battery units in reserve.
EX-CH06-S11.wrong_idea: Log egress before testing the restored camera branch.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Verify camera branch restoration before logging egress; reconcile the 7-unit recovery reserve.
EX-CH06-S11.set_piece: Sunlight touches the south-polar ridge again as the battery gauge holds at 7.

EX-CH06-S12.title: Watching Is Not a Forecast
EX-CH06-S12.story_date: 14 January to February 2047 · monitoring calendar and garden
EX-CH06-S12.goal: Assign the solar-monitoring watch, note the active region without inventing a storm date, and confirm the care ledger
EX-CH06-S12.why: An active region on the Sun is a reason to watch, not a month-ahead storm prediction.

clues.text: Solar image shows an active region; Amara notes that watching is not an exact storm forecast.

EX-CH06-S12.aha: Give every instrument a named watcher, and set no storm date ahead of the evidence.
EX-CH06-S12.wrong_idea: Draw a line from a January active region to a specific February storm date.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Assign monitoring ownership without claiming a month-ahead solar storm forecast.
EX-CH06-S12.set_piece: In the garden, the young cotton plant spreads its true leaves beside the archived mustard petal.

p11_charge_hand_light.title: Charge the hand light
p11_charge_hand_light.goal: Give the scratched hand lamp a measured charge and clip it ready

p11_assign_companion.title: Assign channel companion
p11_assign_companion.goal: Confirm Rafi on the local voice channel throughout the eclipse watch
p11_assign_companion.why: Nobody works an eclipse watch alone.

p11_check_locker.title: Check emergency locker
p11_check_locker.goal: Verify the power-room locker and backup leads before planning the schedule
p11_check_locker.why: Preparation happens while the lights are still normal.

p11_read_personal_log.title: Review Kai's log
p11_read_personal_log.goal: Read or listen to Kai's note on why unscheduled darkness felt endless
p11_read_personal_log.why: Turning a fear into checkable questions makes it manageable.

p11_identify_protected_path.title: Trace the protected guide-light path
p11_identify_protected_path.goal: Verify the guide light sits on the protected essential package across all five segments
p11_identify_protected_path.why: Guide light goes on the protected list alongside circulation, minimum heat and dim growth light.

p11_identify_fault_method.title: Review branch fault isolation
p11_identify_fault_method.goal: Confirm that an auxiliary feeder fault is isolated locally without tripping the main bus
p11_identify_fault_method.why: Protected services stay separate from camera and flood branches.

p11_commit_allocation.title: Commit the 7-unit eclipse plan
p11_commit_allocation.goal: Schedule essentials in all 5 segments (5 units), return pump in segment 1 (1 unit), camera in segment 2 (1 unit), and floodlights OFF (total 7)
p11_commit_allocation.why: Five essentials plus one pump and one camera equal 7 units, preserving the 7-unit recovery reserve.

options.label: Essentials + pump + camera + decorative floods (10 units)
options.detail: Adds 3-unit corridor floodlights, breaching the 7-unit protected reserve.
options.feedback: Blocked by Flight Rule FR-04: spending 10 units breaches the 7-unit recovery reserve. Keep decorative floodlights OFF.

options.label: Drop essentials during totality to save power (6 units)
options.detail: Leaves totality without circulation, minimum heat or the guide light.
options.feedback: Omitting the essential package in totality leaves circulation, garden heat and the guide light unprotected.

options.label: Five essentials (5) + pump in segment 1 (1) + camera in segment 2 (1), floods OFF (total 7)
options.detail: Spends exactly 7 units from the 14-unit jar and preserves 7 units for recovery.

p11_remove_decorative_floods.title: Shed decorative floodlights
p11_remove_decorative_floods.goal: Confirm decorative floodlights stay OFF in the side-by-side comparison
p11_remove_decorative_floods.why: Extra room brightness buys no essential service and spends recovery margin.

p11_protect_guide_light.title: Lock guide-light branch
p11_protect_guide_light.goal: Keep the low-draw guide-light path active in every segment
p11_protect_guide_light.why: You need a known way through the dark, not floodlights.

p11_protect_reserve.title: Confirm 7-unit recovery reserve
p11_protect_reserve.goal: Verify 7 battery units remain reserved for post-eclipse recovery
p11_protect_reserve.why: The 14-unit jar splits cleanly into 7 for the eclipse and 7 for recovery.

p12_test_branch.title: Predict and test safe branch disconnect
p12_test_branch.goal: Open the test branch disconnect and observe that only the auxiliary branch drops
p12_test_branch.why: Predicting the affected branch before switching verifies the isolation boundary.

p12_verify_protected_services.title: Verify protected bus unaffected
p12_verify_protected_services.goal: Confirm air circulation, garden heat and the guide light hold during the branch test
p12_verify_protected_services.why: The isolation boundary keeps habitat services safe.

p12_record_rehearsal.title: Record rehearsal pass
p12_record_rehearsal.goal: Restore the test branch and file the rehearsal separately from the live watch sign-off
p12_record_rehearsal.why: A rehearsal pass prepares the crew; the Go/No-Go signs the watch.

p12_check_four_roles.title: Collect four specialist reports
p12_check_four_roles.goal: Confirm plants (Mei), atmosphere (Amara), shelter/lamp/channel (Rafi) and power (Kai)

p12_check_five_segments.title: Acknowledge five eclipse segments
p12_check_five_segments.goal: Confirm precharge, ingress, totality, egress and recovery on the watch board
p12_check_five_segments.why: Every contact time and segment load is known before ingress.

p12_ready_camera.title: Verify camera protective filter
p12_ready_camera.goal: Confirm the remote camera optical filter is seated before eclipse ingress
p12_ready_camera.why: Never observe without the verified filter configuration.

p12_log_ingress.title: Log eclipse ingress
p12_log_ingress.goal: Record Earth's disc entering the Sun on the filtered remote camera
p12_log_ingress.why: Ingress marks the first contact of the catalog eclipse.

p12_log_ring.title: Log the red ring and atmosphere diagram
p12_log_ring.goal: Record the copper-red ring frame alongside the conceptual Earth-atmosphere cross-section
p12_log_ring.why: Refracted sunlight through Earth's limb lights the lunar eclipse in red.

p12_deliver_family_contact.title: Connect family audio call
p12_deliver_family_contact.goal: Verify the Earth communication window and complete the family audio greeting
p12_deliver_family_contact.why: The call uses the verified Earth-visible contact window.

p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.title: Keep observation qualification labels
p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.goal: Attach the ring observation with Observed, Diagram and Scenario labels intact
p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.why: Honest labels distinguish camera data, conceptual diagrams and scenario timing.

p12_store_known_noor_text.title: Index Noor's red-ring note
p12_store_known_noor_text.goal: File Noor's text note as known correspondence with her earlier eclipse date left unspecified
p12_store_known_noor_text.why: Leave unstated dates blank rather than guessing.

p12_reserve_live_voice.title: Save eclipse records locally
p12_reserve_live_voice.goal: Save ingress, ring and correspondence records locally while keeping live voice reserved for the finale
p12_reserve_live_voice.why: Local saves protect the log before any branch fault.

p12_reset_sequence.title: Restore tripped camera feeder
p12_reset_sequence.goal: Execute the five-step feeder recovery in order without touching the protected main bus
p12_reset_sequence.why: Isolate the faulted feeder and confirm zero current before resetting.

steps.label: Isolate camera feeder
steps.detail: Open the camera branch isolation switch; leave the protected main bus closed.

steps.label: Confirm current = 0 and fault cleared
steps.detail: Verify zero branch current and FAULT CLEARED on the manual indicator.

steps.label: Reset feeder breaker
steps.detail: Throw the camera feeder breaker reset now that the branch is isolated.

steps.label: Close branch isolation
steps.detail: Reconnect the isolated camera feeder to the bus.

steps.label: Test camera branch only
steps.detail: Verify the remote camera view returns while habitat services remain steady.

distractors.label: Reset entire habitat main bus
distractors.feedback: Held by Flight Rule FR-04: never trip the protected main bus for a camera-branch fault.

feedback.order: Follow the safe feeder sequence: isolate feeder, confirm zero and fault cleared, reset breaker, reconnect, then test the camera branch.

p12_record_egress.title: Record eclipse egress
p12_record_egress.goal: Log the restored camera's egress observation to complete the three-part eclipse record
p12_record_egress.why: Ingress, ring and restored egress complete the observation.

p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.title: Reconcile 7-unit recovery reserve
p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.goal: Confirm the battery jar holds 7 units at recovery with zero blackout penalty
p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.why: The 7-unit eclipse plan leaves the 7-unit recovery reserve intact.

p12_save_recovery.title: Save eclipse debrief
p12_save_recovery.goal: Archive the three eclipse observations, the feeder recovery log and Rafi's support checkback
p12_save_recovery.why: Both the interruption and the clean recovery belong in the station record.

p12_reconcile_monitoring.title: Assign solar-monitoring watch
p12_reconcile_monitoring.goal: Assign named watchers to the space-weather instruments after the eclipse
p12_reconcile_monitoring.why: Every instrument needs a clear owner.

p12_date_february_warning.title: Log active solar region
p12_date_february_warning.goal: Pin the active solar region as a monitoring watch without claiming a specific storm date
p12_date_february_warning.why: Watching is not an exact month-ahead storm forecast.

p12_confirm_care_ledger.title: Confirm January care ledger
p12_confirm_care_ledger.goal: Verify the living garden, cotton seedling and protected seed reserves entering February
p12_confirm_care_ledger.why: The garden and crew enter the storm season prepared.
